citations.title: Privacy & Security Standards | DataGrail Documentation
excerpts: **Separation of logic and data:** Vera's "brain" (the AI model, Claude Sonnet 5) is hosted in a completely separate environment (AWS Bedrock) from the core DataGrail database. The AI never has direct access to your data; instead, it accesses your data through a multi-layered security model (more below). **No training on customer data** : Your data is only used as _context_ for the model to provide responses. This means they are read from a database and fed back into the model each time you ask a question.

basis.reasoning: DataGrail’s Vera privacy-and-security documentation names Claude Sonnet 5 as the model and says it is hosted in AWS Bedrock.

citations.title: Job Application for Senior Demand Generation Manager at DataGrail
excerpts: * Own paid media end to end, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube while partnering with our agency on execution.
* Drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables, sharpening targeting and follow-through while focusing investment on what delivers results.
* Carry a quarterly qualified-pipeline number and defend coverage, quality, and conversion with sales leadership, not just volume.
* Architect HubSpot as an owner, managing workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign objects, and the Salesforce sync.
* Build and defend the metrics that matter, including CPL, cost per qualified opportunity, event-sourced pipeline, and multi-touch attribution.
* Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps internally, and agencies, venues, and sponsors externally, to run multiple concurrent campaigns and events without dropping a thread.
## **What You'll Bring**
* A track record of hands-on HubSpot ownership, having personally architected and administered an instance, including workflows, lifecycle, scoring, campaigns, and the Salesforce sync.
* Direct paid media execution, with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and pacing campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, not just briefing an agency.
* Salesforce fluency, with the ability to navigate objects, fields, and reports and reason about how marketing data lands in the CRM and why it breaks.

basis.reasoning: Current DataGrail job postings name Salesforce and Gong in the GTM stack, and the demand-generation role names HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube. These postings provide visible CRM and marketing-stack signals; Gong appears as a familiarity requirement, so the evidence is a signal rather than independent proof of deployment.
